explanation.es: 'Arrangement' (arreglo/disposición) es una palabra A2 más adecuada, que significa la organización planificada de algo: 'Hicimos un arreglo definitivo para la reunión.'

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a system of beliefs, values, and traditions shared by a group'? It is a part of their cultural   {blank} .

explanation.en: A 'tradition' is the transmission of customs or beliefs from generation to generation, or the fact of being passed on in this way.
explanation.zh: 一个 'tradition' (传统) 是指风俗或信仰从一代传到下一代，或以这种方式传承的事实。
explanation.es: Una 'tradition' (tradición) es la transmisión de costumbres o creencias de generación en generación, o el hecho de ser transmitido de esta manera.

questionText.en: Which word describes a thing that is 'related to or characteristic of a particular place'? The festival celebrates the   {blank}  history of the town.

explanation.en: 'Particular' means relating to a specific person or thing.
explanation.zh: 'Particular' (特定的/格外的) 意思是与特定的人或事物相关。
explanation.es: 'Particular' (particular/específico) significa relacionado con una persona o cosa específica.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a small, thick piece of material, often used for cleaning or drying'? I need a clean   {blank}  to dry my face.

explanation.en: A 'towel' is a piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying oneself or wiping things dry.
explanation.zh: 一条 'towel' (毛巾) 是一块用于擦干自己或擦干物品的吸水布或纸。
explanation.es: Una 'towel' (toalla) es un trozo de tela o papel absorbente que se usa para secarse o limpiar cosas.

questionText.en: Which word describes a thing that is 'not usual or what you would expect'? That is a very   {blank}  way to solve the problem.

explanation.en: 'Unusual' means not habitually or commonly occurring or done.
explanation.zh: 'Unusual' (不寻常的/罕见的) 意思是习惯上或通常不会发生或不会做。
explanation.es: 'Unusual' (inusual) significa que no ocurre o se hace habitualmente o comúnmente.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'the person who receives a gift or is invited to an event'? We had a special   {blank}  staying in our house.

explanation.en: A 'guest' is a person who is invited to visit someone's home or attend a particular occasion.
explanation.zh: 一个 'guest' (客人/宾客) 是指被邀请去某人家里拜访或参加特定场合的人。
explanation.es: Un 'guest' (invitado) es una persona que es invitada a visitar la casa de alguien o a asistir a una ocasión en particular.

questionText.en: Which word means 'to start to become visible or present'? I hope the sun will   {blank}  soon.

explanation.en: To 'appear' is to come into sight or view.
explanation.zh: 'Appear' (出现) 是指进入视线或视野。
explanation.es: 'Appear' (aparecer) es entrar a la vista o a la visión.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a person who designs clothes or objects'? I asked a professional   {blank}  to help me with my new logo.

explanation.en: A 'designer' is a person who plans the look or workings of something prior to it being made or built.
explanation.zh: 一个 'designer' (设计师) 是指在某物被制造或建造之前规划其外观或工作原理的人。
explanation.es: Un 'designer' (diseñador) es una persona que planifica el aspecto o el funcionamiento de algo antes de que se haga o se construya.

questionText.en: Which word means 'to put liquid food on top of something'? Would you like some chocolate   {blank}  on your ice cream?

explanation.en: A 'sauce' is a liquid or semi-liquid mixture that is served with food to add flavor, moisture, or visual appeal.
explanation.zh: 一个 'sauce' (酱汁) 是一种液体或半液体混合物，与食物一起食用以增加风味、水分或视觉吸引力。
explanation.es: Una 'sauce' (salsa) es una mezcla líquida o semi-líquida que se sirve con la comida para añadir sabor, humedad o atractivo visual.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a fixed period of work or study'? The university has three   {blank}  per year.

explanation.en: 'Term' means a fixed or limited period for which something lasts or is intended to last, such as a period of a school year.
explanation.zh: 'Term' (学期/期限) 是指某事物持续或旨在持续的固定或有限期限，例如学年中的一个时期。
explanation.es: 'Term' (trimestre/plazo) significa un período fijo o limitado durante el cual algo dura o está destinado a durar, como un período de un año escolar.

questionText.en: Which word means 'to stop something from happening or stop someone from doing something'? The strong fence will   {blank}  animals from entering the garden.

explanation.en: To 'prevent' is to keep (something) from happening or arising.
explanation.zh: 'Prevent' (预防/阻止) 是指阻止（某事）发生或出现。
explanation.es: 'Prevent' (prevenir/evitar) es impedir que (algo) suceda o surja.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a person who is training to be a professional sports player'? The young   {blank}  worked hard every day.

explanation.en: A 'runner' is a person who runs, especially in a race or for pleasure.
explanation.zh: 一个 'runner' (跑步者/赛跑者) 是指跑步的人，尤其是在比赛中或为了乐趣。
explanation.es: Un 'runner' (corredor) es una persona que corre, especialmente en una carrera o por placer.

questionText.en: Which word describes a thing that is 'related to or characteristic of a typical group or kind'? It's a   {blank}  example of a village house.

explanation.en: 'Typical' means possessing the distinguishing characteristics of a particular type or group.
explanation.zh: 'Typical' (典型的) 意思是具有某一特定类型或群体的区别特征。
explanation.es: 'Typical' (típico) significa que posee las características distintivas de un tipo o grupo particular.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'a small toy figure, often of a person or animal'? My sister loves to collect   {blank} .

explanation.en: A 'toy' is an object for a child to play with.
explanation.zh: 一个 'toy' (玩具) 是指供儿童玩耍的物体。
explanation.es: Un 'toy' (juguete) es un objeto para que un niño juegue con él.

questionText.en: Which word means 'to tell someone what you think should happen'? I would like to   {blank}  a new idea for the project.

explanation.en: To 'suggest' is to put forward (an idea or plan) for consideration.
explanation.zh: 'Suggest' (建议) 是指提出（一个想法或计划）供考虑。
explanation.es: 'Suggest' (sugerir) es proponer (una idea o plan) para su consideración.

questionText.en: What is the word for 'an illness that makes you feel very hot and gives you a cough'? I have a terrible   {blank}  and must stay home.

explanation.en: 'Flu' is an infectious disease of the nose, throat, and lungs, caused by a virus and resulting in fever, chills, and muscle aches.
explanation.zh: 'Flu' (流感) 是一种由病毒引起的鼻子、喉咙和肺部的传染病，导致发烧、发冷和肌肉酸痛。
explanation.es: 'Flu' (gripe) es una enfermedad infecciosa de la nariz, la garganta y los pulmones, causada por un virus y que resulta en fiebre, escalofríos y dolores musculares.

questionText.en: Which word means a thick piece of wood from a tree?

explanation.en: Wood is the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wood 指树干和树枝的坚硬材料。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wood es el material duro del que están hechos el tronco y las ramas de un árbol. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: A person who is not strong is often described as what?

explanation.en: Weak means not strong or powerful. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Weak 意为不强壮或没有力量。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Weak significa no fuerte o poderoso. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The opposite of 'strong' is ___.

explanation.en: The opposite of 'strong' is 'weak'. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: 'strong' 的反义词是 'weak'。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Lo opuesto a 'strong' es 'weak'. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: What is the action of moving your hand from side to side to say hello or goodbye?

explanation.en: To wave is to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually to say hello or goodbye. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wave 是指在空中左右挥动你的手或手臂，通常是为了问候或告别。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Hacer wave es mover la mano o el brazo de lado a lado en el aire, generalmente para saludar o despedirse. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The state of feeling anxious and unhappy about something is called ___.

explanation.en: Worry is a state of being anxious and unhappy about something. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Worry 是指对某事感到焦虑和不开心的一种状态。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Worry es un estado de estar ansioso e infeliz por algo. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She felt ___ because she had a big exam tomorrow.

explanation.en: Worried means feeling or showing anxiety and concern about actual or potential problems. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Worried 意为对实际或潜在问题感到或表现出焦虑和担忧。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Worried significa sentir o mostrar ansiedad y preocupación por problemas reales o potenciales. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: Which word describes a substance that has been made into the shape of a wheel?

explanation.en: Wheel is a round object that turns around a central point, used for moving vehicles or machinery. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wheel 是指围绕中心点旋转的圆形物体，用于移动车辆或机器。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wheel es un objeto redondo que gira alrededor de un punto central, utilizado para mover vehículos o maquinaria. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: What do we call the state of having a lot of water or moisture?

explanation.en: Wet means covered or soaked with water or another liquid. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wet 意为被水或其他液体覆盖或浸透。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wet significa cubierto o empapado de agua u otro líquido. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She went to the park ___ the afternoon.

explanation.en: While can be used as a conjunction meaning 'during the time that'. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: While 可以用作连词，意为“在...期间”。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: While puede usarse como conjunción que significa 'durante el tiempo que'. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: Which word describes an animal that lives in nature and not with humans?

explanation.en: Wild means living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wild 意为在自然环境中生活或生长；未驯化或未种植的。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wild significa que vive o crece en el entorno natural; no domesticado ni cultivado. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The river was very ___ after the rain.

explanation.en: Wide means having a large distance from side to side. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wide 意为从一侧到另一侧的距离很大。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wide significa que tiene una gran distancia de lado a lado. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: He made a ___ that he would travel the world.

explanation.en: A wish is a desire or hope for something to happen. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wish 是一种希望某事发生的愿望或期望。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un wish es un deseo o esperanza de que algo suceda. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The person who achieves victory in a game or competition is the ___.

explanation.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Winner 是指赢得某物的人或事物。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un winner es una persona o cosa que gana algo. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The air was moving quickly, so there was a strong ___.

explanation.en: Wind is the movement of air, especially when it moves quickly. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wind 是指空气的运动，尤其是在快速移动时。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wind es el movimiento del aire, especialmente cuando se mueve rápidamente. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She used a ___ of water to clean the car.

explanation.en: A wash can be an act of cleaning something with water and usually soap. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wash 可以是用水和通常是肥皂清洁某物的行为。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un wash puede ser un acto de limpiar algo con agua y generalmente jabón. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The ___ house was made of dark brown wood.

explanation.en: Wooden means made of wood. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wooden 意为由木头制成的。 [cite: 1]

explanation.zh: Tidy 意为排列整齐有序，所以相反的词描述的是凌乱的房间。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Tidy significa arreglado de forma ordenada y en orden, por lo que lo opuesto describiría una habitación desordenada. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: Which word describes something that is not thin?

explanation.en: Thick means having a large distance between opposite sides or surfaces; not thin. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Thick 意为相对两侧或表面之间的距离很大；不薄。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Thick significa tener una gran distancia entre lados o superficies opuestas; no delgado. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: We celebrated when the two halves of the country were ___ again.

explanation.en: United means joined together politically, for a common purpose, or by common feelings. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: United 意为在政治上、为了共同目的或因共同情感而联合在一起。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: United significa unido políticamente, con un propósito común o por sentimientos comunes. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: Which word describes something that is not normal or expected?

explanation.en: Unusual means not commonly occurring or done. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Unusual 意为不经常发生或做的。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Unusual significa que no ocurre o se hace comúnmente. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She went to the kitchen and got a ___ to clean up the spill.

explanation.en: A towel is a piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying oneself or things. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A towel 是一块用于擦干自己或物品的吸水布或纸。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Una towel es un trozo de tela o papel absorbente que se utiliza para secarse a uno mismo o a las cosas. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: He drove the goods in a large delivery ___.

explanation.en: A truck is a large road vehicle for transporting goods. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A truck 是一种用于运输货物的大型道路车辆。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un truck es un vehículo grande de carretera para transportar mercancías. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The mountain was so high, it was an amazing ___ of the landscape.

explanation.en: A view is a sight or prospect, typically of a picturesque setting. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A view 是指景象或前景，通常是风景如画的环境。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Una view es una vista o perspectiva, típicamente de un entorno pintoresco. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She lowered her ___ because she didn't want to wake the baby.

explanation.en: Voice is the sound produced in a person's larynx and uttered through the mouth, as speech or song. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Voice 是指人在喉部发出并通过嘴巴说出或唱出的声音。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Voice es el sonido producido en la laringe de una persona y emitido por la boca, como habla o canción. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The family went on a winter ___ to the snowy mountains.

explanation.en: A tour is a journey for pleasure in which several places are visited. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A tour 是指一次以娱乐为目的的旅行，其中参观了几个地方。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un tour es un viaje por placer en el que se visitan varios lugares. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The air was still and quiet; there was no ___ at all.

explanation.en: Wind is the movement of air, especially when it moves quickly. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Wind 是指空气的运动，尤其是在快速移动时。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Wind es el movimiento del aire, especialmente cuando se mueve rápidamente. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She gave me a piece of paper with instructions on how to ___ the knot.

explanation.en: To tie is to attach or fasten (someone or something) with string or rope. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: To tie 是指用细绳或绳子连接或固定（某人或某物）。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: To tie es atar o sujetar (a alguien o algo) con cuerda o soga. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The coach gave us a valuable ___ on how to improve our game.

explanation.en: A tip can mean a piece of advice or useful suggestion. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A tip 可以指一条建议或有用的提议。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Una tip puede significar un consejo o sugerencia útil. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: He put the luggage in the back of his small delivery ___.

explanation.en: A van is a medium-sized motor vehicle, typically without side windows in the rear, used for transporting goods or people. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A van 是一种中型机动车辆，通常后部没有侧窗，用于运输货物或人员。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Una van es un vehículo de motor de tamaño medio, típicamente sin ventanas laterales en la parte trasera, utilizado para transportar mercancías o personas. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The police were looking for the ___ who stole the jewellery.

explanation.en: A thief is a person who steals another person's property. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: A thief 是指偷窃他人财产的人。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Un thief es una persona que roba la propiedad de otra persona. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: The city has a wide ___ of restaurants, from Italian to Asian.

explanation.en: Variety is the fact or quality of being different or diverse. [cite: 1]
explanation.zh: Variety 是指不同或多样化的事实或品质。 [cite: 1]
explanation.es: Variety es el hecho o la cualidad de ser diferente o diverso. [cite: 1]

questionText.en: She used her small, flat computer screen, called a ___, to read a book.

explanation.en: A tablet is a thin, lighter-weight mobile computer that is typically a touch screen.
explanation.zh: A tablet 是一种轻薄的移动电脑，通常是触摸屏。
explanation.es: Una tablet es una computadora móvil delgada y ligera que suele ser una pantalla táctil.

questionText.en: The archer aimed his arrow at the circular red and white ___.

explanation.en: A target is a mark or object aimed at, or a goal to be achieved.
explanation.zh: A target 是指瞄准的标记或物体，或要实现的目标。
explanation.es: Un target es una marca u objeto al que se apunta, o una meta a alcanzar.

questionText.en: The professor is responsible for the ___ of English to new students.

explanation.en: Teaching is the job or activity of a teacher.
explanation.zh: Teaching 是指教师的工作或活动。
explanation.es: Teaching es el trabajo o la actividad de un profesor.

questionText.en: The ages between 13 and 19 are known as the ___ years.

explanation.en: Teenage describes the period of human development between childhood and adulthood.
explanation.zh: Teenage 描述了人类从童年到成年的发展时期。
explanation.es: Teenage describe el período de desarrollo humano entre la infancia y la edad adulta.

questionText.en: The last school ___ ends in June, just before the summer holiday.

explanation.en: A term is one of the periods into which a year is divided, especially for students.
explanation.zh: A term 是指一年被划分成的周期之一，特别是对学生而言。
explanation.es: Un term es uno de los períodos en los que se divide un año, especialmente para los estudiantes.

questionText.en: She sent a quick ___ message to her friend using her phone.

explanation.en: Text refers to a written or printed work, or a short message sent electronically.
explanation.zh: Text 是指书面或印刷作品，或以电子方式发送的短消息。
explanation.es: Text se refiere a una obra escrita o impresa, o un mensaje corto enviado electrónicamente.

questionText.en: The children built the sandcastle all by ___.

explanation.en: Themselves is the reflexive pronoun for 'they' or 'them'.
explanation.zh: Themselves 是 'they' 或 'them' 的反身代词。
explanation.es: Themselves es el pronombre reflexivo para 'they' o 'them'.

questionText.en: She was lost in her own ___ and didn't hear the bell ring.

explanation.en: Thinking is the process of considering or reasoning about something.
explanation.zh: Thinking 是指考虑或推理某事的过程。
explanation.es: Thinking es el proceso de considerar o razonar sobre algo.

questionText.en: The medal was given to the person who finished in ___ place in the race.

explanation.en: Third is the ordinal number for three.
explanation.zh: Third 是数字三的序数词。
explanation.es: Third es el número ordinal para tres.

questionText.en: The whole country's railway ___ was shut down due to the snow.

explanation.en: A system is a set of things working together as parts of a mechanism or an interconnecting network.
explanation.zh: A system 是指一组事物作为一个机制或相互连接的网络的一部分一起工作。
explanation.es: Un system es un conjunto de cosas que trabajan juntas como partes de un mecanismo o una red interconectada.

questionText.en: A red heart is a common ___ of love.

explanation.en: A symbol is a mark or character used to represent an object, function, or process.
explanation.zh: A symbol 是指用来代表物体、功能或过程的标记或字符。
explanation.es: Un symbol es una marca o carácter utilizado para representar un objeto, función o proceso.

questionText.en: The cake was very rich and tasted quite ___.

explanation.en: Sweet means having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey; not sour, salty, or bitter.
explanation.zh: Sweet 意为具有糖或蜂蜜的宜人味道；不酸、不咸或不苦。
explanation.es: Sweet significa tener el sabor agradable característico del azúcar o la miel; no agrio, salado o amargo.

questionText.en: The company conducted a ___ to ask customers about their satisfaction.

explanation.en: A survey is an investigation of the opinions or experiences of a group of people, often by asking them questions.
explanation.zh: A survey 是指对一群人的意见或经验进行的调查，通常通过向他们提问。
explanation.es: Una survey es una investigación de las opiniones o experiencias de un grupo de personas, a menudo haciéndoles preguntas.

questionText.en: It was ___ to see him win the race because he hadn't trained much.

explanation.en: Surprising means causing surprise; unexpected.
explanation.zh: Surprising 意为引起惊喜；出乎意料的。
explanation.es: Surprising significa causar sorpresa; inesperado.

questionText.en: She was very ___ when she saw all her friends at the party.

explanation.en: Surprised means feeling or showing surprise.
explanation.zh: Surprised 意为感到或表现出惊讶。
explanation.es: Surprised significa sentir o mostrar sorpresa.

questionText.en: The party was a complete ___ for his birthday.

explanation.en: A surprise is an unexpected event, fact, or thing.
explanation.zh: A surprise 是指一个意想不到的事件、事实或事物。
explanation.es: Una surprise es un evento, hecho o cosa inesperada.

questionText.en: I ___ you are tired after such a long journey.

explanation.en: To suppose means to assume that something is true or probable.
explanation.zh: To suppose 意为假设某事是真的或可能的。
explanation.es: To suppose significa asumir que algo es verdadero o probable.

questionText.en: The charity gives emotional and financial ___ to local families.

explanation.en: Support is to hold up or help someone/something.
explanation.zh: Support 是指支持或帮助某人/某事。
explanation.es: Support es sostener o ayudar a alguien/algo.

questionText.en: He wore a smart blue ___ to the wedding.

explanation.en: A suit is a set of outer clothes made of the same fabric and designed to be worn together.
explanation.zh: A suit 是一套由相同布料制成并设计成一起穿着的外衣。
explanation.es: Un suit es un conjunto de ropa exterior hecho de la misma tela y diseñado para ser usado junto.

questionText.en: Do you have any ___ for a good restaurant near here?

explanation.en: A suggestion is an idea or plan put forward for consideration.
explanation.zh: A suggestion 是指提出供考虑的想法或计划。
explanation.es: Una suggestion es una idea o plan presentado para su consideración.

questionText.en: I ___ we go to the cinema tonight instead of staying home.

explanation.en: To suggest is to put forward for consideration.
explanation.zh: To suggest 是指提出供考虑。
explanation.es: To suggest es proponer para su consideración.

questionText.en: The lights went out, and ___ the room was completely dark.

explanation.en: Suddenly means quickly and unexpectedly.
explanation.zh: Suddenly 意为快速且出乎意料地。
explanation.es: Suddenly significa rápida e inesperadamente.

questionText.en: I have never seen ___ a beautiful view before.

explanation.en: Such is used before a noun phrase to add emphasis or to mean 'of a kind specified or understood'.
explanation.zh: Such 用于名词短语之前以增加强调或表示'指定或理解的种类'。
explanation.es: Such se usa antes de una frase nominal para enfatizar o para significar 'de un tipo especificado o entendido'.

questionText.en: After years of hard work, she became a very ___ business owner.

explanation.en: Successful means accomplishing an aim or purpose.
explanation.zh: Successful 意为实现目标或目的。
explanation.es: Successful significa lograr un objetivo o propósito.

questionText.en: If you work hard, you will eventually ___ in your goals.

explanation.en: To succeed is to achieve the desired aim or result.
explanation.zh: To succeed 是指实现期望的目标或结果。
explanation.es: To succeed es lograr el objetivo o resultado deseado.

questionText.en: It was ___ of him to forget his own birthday.

explanation.en: Stupid means lacking intelligence or common sense.
explanation.zh: Stupid 意为缺乏智力或常识。
explanation.es: Stupid significa carecer de inteligencia o sentido común.

questionText.en: The new bridge has a very strong concrete ___.

explanation.en: Structure is the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.
explanation.zh: Structure 是指复杂事物各部分或元素之间的排列和关系。
explanation.es: Structure es la disposición y las relaciones entre las partes o elementos de algo complejo.

questionText.en: Taking a break can help reduce the ___ of a difficult day at work.

explanation.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.
explanation.zh: Stress 是指由不利或苛刻的环境导致的心理或情感紧张状态。
explanation.es: Stress es un estado de tensión o esfuerzo mental o emocional resultante de circunstancias adversas o exigentes.

questionText.en: The chess player used a clever ___ to win the game quickly.

explanation.en: A strategy is a plan of action designed to achieve a long-term or overall aim.
explanation.zh: A strategy 是指旨在实现长期或总体目标的行动计划。
explanation.es: Una strategy es un plan de acción diseñado para lograr un objetivo a largo plazo o general.

questionText.en: I had a very ___ dream last night about flying elephants.

explanation.en: Strange means unusual or surprising in a way that is unsettling or hard to understand.
explanation.zh: Strange 意为不同寻常或令人惊讶，令人不安或难以理解。
explanation.es: Strange significa inusual o sorprendente de una manera inquietante o difícil de entender.

questionText.en: Turn left here, and then drive ___ for about two miles.

explanation.en: Straight means moving in one direction only; without turning or curving.
explanation.zh: Straight 意为只朝一个方向移动；不转弯或弯曲。
explanation.es: Straight significa moverse en una sola dirección; sin girar ni curvarse.

questionText.en: A strong wind and heavy rain is what we call a ___.

explanation.en: A storm is a violent disturbance of the atmosphere with strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.
explanation.zh: A storm 是指伴有强风和通常有雨、雷、闪电或雪的大气剧烈扰动。
explanation.es: Una storm es una perturbación violenta de la atmósfera con fuertes vientos y generalmente lluvia, truenos, relámpagos o nieve.

questionText.en: We bought all the ingredients at the local grocery ___.

explanation.en: A store is a large shop, especially in North American English.
explanation.zh: A store 是指一家大商店，尤其在北美英语中。
explanation.es: Una store es una tienda grande, especialmente en inglés norteamericano.

questionText.en: The child picked up a smooth, grey ___ from the river bank.

explanation.en: A stone is a small piece of rock.
explanation.zh: A stone 是一小块岩石。
explanation.es: Una stone es un pequeño trozo de roca.

questionText.en: If you eat too much, you might get a pain in your ___.

explanation.en: Stomach is the internal organ where the major part of the digestion of food occurs.
explanation.zh: Stomach 是发生食物消化主要部分的内部器官。
explanation.es: Stomach es el órgano interno donde ocurre la mayor parte de la digestión de los alimentos.

questionText.en: Be careful when you take the first ___ onto the ladder.

explanation.en: A step is a movement made by lifting and setting down one's foot or suddenly starting something.
explanation.zh: A step 是指抬起和放下脚的动作或突然开始某事。
explanation.es: Un step es un movimiento realizado levantando y poniendo el pie o comenzando algo de repente.

questionText.en: The law says it is wrong to ___ money from others.

explanation.en: To steal is to take (another person's property) without permission or legal right and without intending to return it.
explanation.zh: To steal 是指未经许可或法律权利拿走（他人的财产）并且不打算归还。
explanation.es: To steal es tomar (la propiedad de otra persona) sin permiso o derecho legal y sin la intención de devolverla.

questionText.en: The politician gave a speech about the future of the ___.

explanation.en: A state is a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.
explanation.zh: A state 是指被视为一个有组织的政治社区在一个政府下的国家或领土。
explanation.es: Un state es una nación o territorio considerado como una comunidad política organizada bajo un solo gobierno.

questionText.en: I need a ___ to send this letter by post.

explanation.en: A stamp is a small adhesive piece of paper to be affixed to a letter or package before mailing, showing the amount of postage paid.
explanation.zh: A stamp 是一小块不干胶纸，贴在信件或包裹上，显示已付邮资的金额。
explanation.es: Un stamp es un pequeño trozo de papel adhesivo que se coloca en una carta o paquete antes de enviarlo por correo, mostrando la cantidad de franqueo pagado.

questionText.en: Be careful on the slippery ___ when you walk down to the first floor.

explanation.en: A stair is one of a set of steps leading from one floor or level to another.
explanation.zh: A stair 是指从一层或一个级别通往另一个的一组台阶之一。
explanation.es: Una stair es uno de un conjunto de escalones que conducen de un piso o nivel a otro.

questionText.en: The band played their music on the large wooden ___ at the concert.

explanation.en: A stage is a raised platform on which actors, entertainers, or speakers perform.
explanation.zh: A stage 是指演员、艺人或演讲者表演的凸起平台。
explanation.es: Un stage es una plataforma elevada en la que actúan actores, artistas o oradores.

questionText.en: A field with four equal sides and four right angles is a ___.

explanation.en: A square is a plane figure with four equal straight sides and four right angles.
explanation.zh: A square 是一种平面图形，有四条相等的直线边和四个直角。
explanation.es: Un square es una figura plana con cuatro lados rectos iguales y cuatro ángulos rectos.

questionText.en: I used a clean ___ to eat my soup.

explanation.en: A spoon is an implement consisting of a small, shallow oval or round bowl at the end of a handle, used for eating, stirring, and serving food.
explanation.zh: A spoon 是一种由手柄末端的一个小的、浅的椭圆形或圆形碗组成的器具，用于进食、搅拌和上菜。
explanation.es: Una spoon es un utensilio que consiste en un cuenco pequeño, poco profundo, ovalado o redondo al final de un mango, utilizado para comer, remover y servir alimentos.

questionText.en: Which insect has eight legs and builds a silk web to catch prey?

explanation.en: A spider is an eight-legged predatory arachnid with an unsegmented body.
explanation.zh: A spider 是一种有八条腿的掠食性蜘蛛纲动物，身体无分节。
explanation.es: Una spider es un arácnido depredador de ocho patas con un cuerpo no segmentado.

questionText.en: The sign said the maximum driving ___ was 60 miles per hour.

explanation.en: Speed is the rate at which someone or something is able to move or operate.
explanation.zh: Speed 是指某人或某物能够移动或操作的速度。
explanation.es: Speed es la velocidad a la que alguien o algo puede moverse u operar.

questionText.en: The president will give a ___ to the public tomorrow morning.

explanation.en: A speech is a formal address delivered to an audience.
explanation.zh: A speech 是指向听众发表的正式讲话。
explanation.es: Un speech es un discurso formal pronunciado ante una audiencia.

questionText.en: I need you to be more ___ about what you need from the shop.

explanation.en: Specific means clearly defined or identified.
explanation.zh: Specific 意为明确定义或识别的。
explanation.es: Specific significa claramente definido o identificado.

questionText.en: Who is the main ___ at this conference about new technology?

explanation.en: A speaker is a person who delivers a speech or lecture.
explanation.zh: A speaker 是指发表演讲或讲座的人。
explanation.es: Un speaker es una persona que pronuncia un discurso o una conferencia.

questionText.en: What is the original ___ of this quotation?

explanation.en: A source is a place, person, or thing from which something originates or can be obtained.
explanation.zh: A source 是指某事物起源或可以获得的地方、人物或事物。
explanation.es: Una source es un lugar, persona o cosa de la que algo se origina o se puede obtener.

questionText.en: I am interested in every ___ of classical music.

explanation.en: Sort is a category of people or things having some properties in common; a kind.
explanation.zh: Sort 是指具有某些共同属性的一类人或事物；一种。
explanation.es: Sort es una categoría de personas o cosas que tienen algunas propiedades en común; un tipo.

questionText.en: The man was wearing only one ___ on his left foot.

explanation.en: A sock is a garment for the foot and lower part of the leg.
explanation.zh: A sock 是指用于脚部和小腿的服装。
explanation.es: Un sock es una prenda para el pie y la parte inferior de la pierna.

questionText.en: He works for a national ___ that helps fight poverty.

explanation.en: Society is the aggregate of people living together in a more or less ordered community.
explanation.zh: Society 是指聚集在一起生活在一个或多或少有秩序的社区中的人们。
explanation.es: Society es el conjunto de personas que viven juntas en una comunidad más o menos ordenada.

questionText.en: He spends a lot of time on ___ media, like Facebook and Twitter.

explanation.en: Social means relating to society or its organization.
explanation.zh: Social 意为与社会或其组织相关的。
explanation.es: Social significa relacionado con la sociedad o su organización.

questionText.en: A popular team sport played with a round ball is ___.

explanation.en: Soccer (or football) is a game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball.
explanation.zh: Soccer（或 football）是两队各十一人用一个圆球进行的一项运动。
explanation.es: Soccer (o fútbol) es un juego jugado por dos equipos de once jugadores con una pelota redonda.

questionText.en: She washed her hands with water and ___ before dinner.

explanation.en: Soap is a substance used with water for washing and cleaning.
explanation.zh: Soap 是一种与水一起用于洗涤和清洁的物质。
explanation.es: Soap es una sustancia utilizada con agua para lavar y limpiar.

questionText.en: The sign said 'No ___ in the entire building.'

explanation.en: Smoking is the action of inhaling and exhaling the smoke of tobacco or a drug.
explanation.zh: Smoking 是指吸入和呼出烟草或药物烟雾的行为。
explanation.es: Smoking es la acción de inhalar y exhalar el humo del tabaco o de una droga.

questionText.en: She gave a friendly ___ to the new neighbour.

explanation.en: A smile is a facial expression indicating pleasure, approval, or amusement.
explanation.zh: A smile 是一种表示愉悦、赞同或娱乐的面部表情。
explanation.es: Una smile es una expresión facial que indica placer, aprobación o diversión.

questionText.en: The beautiful aroma was the wonderful ___ of fresh coffee.

explanation.en: Smell is the faculty or sense by which the presence of an odour or fragrance is perceived.
explanation.zh: Smell 是指感知气味或香味的存在的能力或感觉。
explanation.es: Smell es la facultad o sentido por el cual se percibe la presencia de un olor o fragancia.

questionText.en: We walked very ___ so that we wouldn't wake the baby.

explanation.en: Slowly means at a slow speed; not quickly.
explanation.zh: Slowly 意为以慢速；不快。
explanation.es: Slowly significa a una velocidad lenta; no rápidamente.

questionText.en: Which activity involves moving over snow on long, thin strips of wood or plastic?

explanation.en: Skiing is the action of travelling over snow on skis.
explanation.zh: Skiing 是指在雪地上滑雪的动作。
explanation.es: Skiing es la acción de viajar sobre la nieve con esquís.

questionText.en: I need to know the ___ of the T-shirt before I buy it.

explanation.en: Size is the overall magnitude or extent of something; a numerical measure of a person's clothes.
explanation.zh: Size 是指某物的总体大小或范围；一个人衣服的数字测量。
explanation.es: Size es la magnitud o extensión general de algo; una medida numérica de la ropa de una persona.

questionText.en: The website is the company's official internet ___.

explanation.en: A site is an area of ground on which a town, building, or monument is constructed.
explanation.zh: A site 是指建造城镇、建筑物或纪念碑的地面区域。
explanation.es: Un site es un área de terreno en la que se construye una ciudad, un edificio o un monumento.

questionText.en: The man bowed and addressed the older gentleman as '___'.

explanation.en: Sir is a polite or respectful way of addressing a man.
explanation.zh: Sir 是指礼貌或尊重地称呼男士的方式。
explanation.es: Sir es una forma educada o respetuosa de dirigirse a un hombre.

questionText.en: The opposite of 'married' is '___'.

explanation.en: Single means not married or in a stable relationship.
explanation.zh: Single 意为未婚或没有稳定关系。
explanation.es: Single significa no casado o no en una relación estable.

questionText.en: She enjoys ___ folk songs in a local choir.

explanation.en: Singing is the activity of making musical sounds with the voice.
explanation.zh: Singing 是指用声音发出音乐声音的活动。
explanation.es: Singing es la actividad de hacer sonidos musicales con la voz.

questionText.en: I have been working at this company ___ 2010.

explanation.en: Since is used to refer to a point in time before the present.
explanation.zh: Since 用于指代现在之前的时间点。
explanation.es: Since se usa para referirse a un punto en el tiempo anterior al presente.

questionText.en: The instructions were very easy to follow because they were written in ___ language.

explanation.en: Simple means easily understood or done; not complicated.
explanation.zh: Simple 意为容易理解或完成；不复杂。
explanation.es: Simple significa fácilmente entendido o hecho; no complicado.

questionText.en: The vase was made of beautiful polished ___.

explanation.en: Silver is a precious metal, typically white-ish grey and used for jewellery and cutlery.
explanation.zh: Silver 是一种贵金属，通常呈灰白色，用于珠宝和餐具。
explanation.es: Silver es un metal precioso, típicamente gris blanquecino y utilizado para joyería y cubiertos.

questionText.en: He put up a 'For Sale' ___ in the window of his car.

explanation.en: A sign is an object, quality, or event whose presence or occurrence indicates the probable presence or occurrence of something else.
explanation.zh: A sign 是指其存在或发生表明其他事物可能存在或发生的物体、品质或事件。
explanation.es: Un sign es un objeto, cualidad o evento cuya presencia u ocurrencia indica la probable presencia u ocurrencia de otra cosa.

questionText.en: The best place to sit is on the left ___ of the bus.

explanation.en: Side is a position to the left or right of an object or central point.
explanation.zh: Side 是指物体或中心点左侧或右侧的位置。
explanation.es: Side es una posición a la izquierda o derecha de un objeto o punto central.

questionText.en: Please ___ the door when you leave the room.

explanation.en: To shut is to close (something) firmly or completely.
explanation.zh: To shut 是指用力或完全关闭（某物）。
explanation.es: To shut es cerrar (algo) con firmeza o completamente.

questionText.en: The crowd began to ___ loudly when the band came on stage.

explanation.en: To shout is to utter a loud cry, typically of pain, fear, or excitement.
explanation.zh: To shout 是指发出大喊声，通常是痛苦、恐惧或兴奋的。
explanation.es: To shout es proferir un grito fuerte, típicamente de dolor, miedo o emoción.

questionText.en: He carried the heavy box on his ___.

explanation.en: A shoulder is the joint connecting the arm or forelimb to the body.
explanation.zh: A shoulder 是指连接手臂或前肢与身体的关节。
explanation.es: Un shoulder es la articulación que conecta el brazo o la extremidad anterior al cuerpo.

questionText.en: A large boat used for carrying people or goods across the sea is a ___.

explanation.en: A ship is a large boat for transporting people or goods by sea.
explanation.zh: A ship 是指用于海上运输人员或货物的大船。
explanation.es: Un ship es un barco grande para transportar personas o mercancías por mar.

questionText.en: I need a clean ___ of paper to write a letter.

explanation.en: A sheet is a broad, flat, thin piece of paper, metal, glass, or other material.
explanation.zh: A sheet 是一块宽阔、扁平、薄的纸、金属、玻璃或其他材料。
explanation.es: Una sheet es una pieza ancha, plana y delgada de papel, metal, vidrio u otro material.

questionText.en: The box had a round ___ but the table was square.

explanation.en: A shape is the external form or outline of someone or something.
explanation.zh: A shape 是指某人或某物的外部形式或轮廓。
explanation.es: Un shape es la forma o el contorno externo de alguien o algo.

questionText.en: ___ we go to the park this afternoon?

explanation.en: Shall is used to form questions suggesting an action or offering a service.
explanation.zh: Shall 用于构成建议行动或提供服务的疑问句。
explanation.es: Shall se usa para formar preguntas que sugieren una acción u ofrecen un servicio.

questionText.en: He tried to ___ the bottle, but the lid was too tight.

explanation.en: To shake is to move or wave rapidly to and fro or up and down.
explanation.zh: To shake 是指快速地来回或上下移动或挥动。
explanation.es: To shake es mover u ondear rápidamente de un lado a otro o de arriba abajo.

questionText.en: There are ___ reasons why I can't come to the party tonight.

explanation.en: Several means more than two but not many.
explanation.zh: Several 意为多于两个但不多。
explanation.es: Several significa más de dos, pero no muchos.

questionText.en: The waiter will ___ us our food when it is ready.

explanation.en: To serve is to perform duties or services for (another person or an organization).
explanation.zh: To serve 是指为（另一个人或组织）履行职责或服务。
explanation.es: To serve es realizar deberes o servicios para (otra persona o una organización).

questionText.en: Which word describes a paid job done for others?

explanation.en: Service is the action of helping or doing work for someone.
explanation.zh: Service 是指帮助或为某人工作的行为。
explanation.es: Service es la acción de ayudar o hacer trabajo para alguien.

questionText.en: That news reporter always sounds very ___ when she talks about politics.

explanation.en: Serious means acting or speaking sincerely and with deep intention.
explanation.zh: Serious 意为真诚而带有深意的行为或说话。
explanation.es: Serious significa actuar o hablar con sinceridad y con profunda intención.

questionText.en: The detective followed a ___ of clues to find the lost item.

explanation.en: A series is a number of similar or related things coming one after another.
explanation.zh: A series 是指一系列相似或相关的事物接连而来。
explanation.es: Una series es un número de cosas similares o relacionadas que vienen una tras otra.

questionText.en: The artist tried to ___ the blue from the green when mixing colours.

explanation.en: To separate is to move or keep (people or things) apart.
explanation.zh: To separate 是指移动或保持（人或物）分开。
explanation.es: To separate es mover o mantener (personas o cosas) separadas.

questionText.en: The politician tried to make ___ of the confusing economic data.

explanation.en: Sense is a faculty by which the body perceives an external stimulus, or a sound practical judgment.
explanation.zh: Sense 是指身体感知外部刺激的官能，或健全的实用判断。
explanation.es: Sense es una facultad por la cual el cuerpo percibe un estímulo externo, o un juicio práctico sólido.

questionText.en: It does not ___ to worry about things you cannot change.

explanation.en: To seem is to give the impression of being something or doing something; to appear.
explanation.zh: To seem 是指给人留下是某物或做某事的印象；显得。
explanation.es: To seem es dar la impresión de ser algo o hacer algo; aparecer.

questionText.en: Please write down the name and phone number of your personal ___.

explanation.en: A secretary is a person employed by an individual or in an office to assist with correspondence, keep records, etc.
explanation.zh: A secretary 是指受雇于个人或办公室协助处理信函、记录等的职员。
explanation.es: Un secretary es una persona empleada por un individuo o en una oficina para ayudar con la correspondencia, mantener registros, etc.

questionText.en: She told me a deep, dark ___ that she asked me not to share.

explanation.en: A secret is something that is kept hidden or that is known about by only a few people.
explanation.zh: A secret 是指隐藏起来或只有少数人知道的事情。
explanation.es: Un secret es algo que se mantiene oculto o que solo unas pocas personas conocen.

questionText.en: First, we cleaned the floor; ___, we washed the windows.

explanation.en: Secondly is used to introduce the second point or reason in a series.
explanation.zh: Secondly 用于介绍系列中的第二个要点或原因。
explanation.es: Secondly se utiliza para introducir el segundo punto o razón en una serie.

questionText.en: She chose a nice window ___ on the train.

explanation.en: A seat is a thing designed to be sat on, such as a chair.
explanation.zh: A seat 是指设计用于坐的东西，例如椅子。
explanation.es: Un seat es algo diseñado para sentarse, como una silla.

questionText.en: My favourite ___ is autumn because of the beautiful colours.

explanation.en: A season is each of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter).
explanation.zh: A season 是指一年中的四个划分（春、夏、秋、冬）之一。
explanation.es: Una season es cada una de las cuatro divisiones del año (primavera, verano, otoño e invierno).

questionText.en: You can use the internet to ___ for information about any topic.

explanation.en: To search is to try to find something by looking or otherwise seeking carefully and thoroughly.
explanation.zh: To search 是指通过仔细彻底地查看或以其他方式寻找来尝试找到某物。
explanation.es: To search es intentar encontrar algo mirando o buscando de otra manera con cuidado y minuciosidad.

questionText.en: She managed to ___ enough money to buy a new car.

explanation.en: To save is to keep and store up (something, especially money) for future use.
explanation.zh: To save 是指保存和储存（某物，尤其是金钱）以备将来使用。
explanation.es: To save es guardar y almacenar (algo, especialmente dinero) para uso futuro.

questionText.en: The sea was very rough, but they continued to ___ their boat.

explanation.en: To sail is to travel in a boat or ship, especially one driven by wind or by a motor.
explanation.zh: To sail 是指乘船或乘舰艇旅行，尤其是由风或马达驱动的。
explanation.es: To sail es viajar en un barco o nave, especialmente uno impulsado por el viento o por un motor.

questionText.en: The children were kept ___ behind the wall during the storm.

explanation.en: Safe means protected from or not exposed to danger or risk.
explanation.zh: Safe 意为受到保护或未暴露于危险或风险之中。
explanation.es: Safe significa protegido de o no expuesto a peligro o riesgo.

questionText.en: I usually listen to music on my ___ when I go for a walk.

explanation.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that performs many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touch screen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded apps.
explanation.zh: A smartphone 是一种移动电话，通常具有触摸屏界面、互联网接入和能够运行下载应用的操作系统，可执行计算机的许多功能。
explanation.es: Un smartphone es un teléfono móvil que realiza muchas de las funciones de una computadora, típicamente tiene una interfaz de pantalla táctil, acceso a internet y un sistema operativo capaz de ejecutar aplicaciones descargadas.

questionText.en: I need to go to the ___ to buy some new shoes.

explanation.en: A store is a large shop, especially in North American English.
explanation.zh: A store 是指一家大商店，尤其在北美英语中。
explanation.es: Una store es una tienda grande, especialmente en inglés norteamericano.

questionText.en: The answer to the puzzle gave us the ___ to the problem.

explanation.en: A solution is a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.
explanation.zh: A solution 是指解决问题或处理困难情况的方法。
explanation.es: Una solution es un medio para resolver un problema o lidiar con una situación difícil.

questionText.en: The ice cream was warm and ___ after being in the sun.

explanation.en: Soft means easily yielding to pressure, touch, or heat; not hard or firm.
explanation.zh: Soft 意为容易屈服于压力、触摸或热量；不硬或不坚定。
explanation.es: Soft significa que cede fácilmente a la presión, el tacto o el calor; no duro ni firme.

questionText.en: A person who serves in an army is called a ___.

explanation.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.
explanation.zh: A soldier 是指在军队中服役的人。
explanation.es: Un soldier es una persona que sirve en un ejército.
